content.summary: Research findings for: TUI task/subagent rendering and mcp_opencode_task updates

data.original_input: Explore how the TUI renders task/subagent info and why subagent tool calls (mcp_opencode_task) are not shown or updated in real time.

codebase_findings.finding: Session route renders messages in a scrollbox; AssistantMessage maps parts to TextPart/ReasoningPart/ToolPart; ToolPart dispatches to per-tool renderers. Task tool uses metadata.summary and input.subagent_type to display subagent info and navigate to child session.
codebase_findings.evidence: ToolPart -> Task component shows description, toolcall count, last non-pending tool, and uses metadata.sessionId for navigation.

codebase_findings.finding: TUI state is event-driven; sdk.event.listen updates message/part stores on message.part.updated, message.updated, session.updated, etc., which drives re-renders.
codebase_findings.evidence: Sync store maps parts by messageID and updates on event types, enabling reactive rendering in Session.

codebase_findings.finding: SDK provider subscribes to server SSE via sdk.event.subscribe and batches events into a Solid global emitter for UI updates.
codebase_findings.evidence: Event queue flushes every ~16ms to batch renders.

codebase_findings.finding: Task tool spawns subagent session, subscribes to MessageV2.PartUpdated for that session, and updates ctx.metadata.summary with tool calls and sessionId for the parent tool part.
codebase_findings.evidence: Bus.subscribe collects tool parts, marks nested task tools as isSubagent, and calls ctx.metadata with summary/sessionId/model.

codebase_findings.finding: Subtask execution path creates a Task tool part in the parent session and updates its state/metadata via ctx.metadata during execution; final metadata from Task tool is applied on completion.
codebase_findings.evidence: taskCtx.metadata updates the running ToolPart state; completion writes title/metadata/output.

codebase_findings.finding: Claude Agent SDK stream normalizes MCP tool names (mcp__opencode__task -> task). Tool_use_summary becomes tool-result metadata with only a summary string; no merge of stored metadata.
codebase_findings.evidence: normalizeToolName strips mcp__opencode__ prefix; tool_use_summary creates tool-result with metadata { summary } only.

codebase_findings.finding: Tool metadata updates require tool_use_id/callID. If missing, ctx.metadata cannot update ToolPart; metadata is stored in ToolMetadataRegistry but there is no retrieval usage shown in codebase.
codebase_findings.evidence: updateToolMetadata bails when callID missing; ToolMetadataRegistry.store is called post-execution but no retrieve references found.

codebase_findings.finding: Agent name/color in Task UI comes from input.subagent_type and local.agent.color (based on sync agent list; subagents are excluded from selectable list but still colored).

prior_art.note: Prior work mentions mcp_opencode_task naming; relevant to tool name normalization path.

patterns: SolidJS + OpenTUI components; Session route owns rendering and toggles visibility (showDetails/showThinking).
UI renders only current session parts; child/subagent tool calls are surfaced only via Task tool metadata summary.
Task tool progress depends on ctx.metadata updates which require tool_use_id/callID.
raw_options: Trace and fix MCP tool_use_id propagation so ctx.metadata updates reach Task ToolPart during execution.
Merge ToolMetadataRegistry into tool_use_summary processing so metadata.summary shows up for MCP tools.
TUI fetches child session parts using metadata.sessionId and renders a live toolcall list inline.
Extend Task component to show the full summary list (not just last) plus counts/status badges.
Add server-side event that mirrors child session tool updates into parent session metadata.
